install: Run with npx at a pinned version or install as a dev dependency.

items.name: LLMLingua
items.summary: Microsoft prompt compression (LLMLingua, LongLLMLingua, LLMLingua-2) using small models to drop low-information tokens.
items.useWhen: Use instead of naive truncation to compress long RAG context or transcripts, often by several times, before calling an expensive model.
cautions: Compression is lossy; evaluate answer quality on your data.
Requires a local compressor model (torch).
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: promptfoo
items.summary: CLI and library for prompt/model evals, regression tests and LLM red teaming with declarative configs.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing eval harnesses; compare prompts and models on cost and tokens to pick the cheapest passing option.
cautions: Evals against real providers cost money; mark them explicit and keep CI on fakes or caches.
Telemetry is on by default; set PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Ragas
items.summary: Evaluation toolkit for RAG and agent pipelines with faithfulness, relevance and context metrics.
items.useWhen: Use instead of inventing RAG quality metrics; context precision/recall shows when you can retrieve fewer chunks.
cautions: LLM-judged metrics cost tokens and are noisy; fix judge model and seeds.
install: Package: pypi ragas (registry metadata does not state the license; confirm against the upstream LICENSE).
Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: DeepEval
items.summary: Pytest-style LLM evaluation framework with G-Eval, RAG, agent and safety metrics.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing LLM unit tests and judge prompts in Python test suites.
cautions: Confident AI platform is a separate paid service; opt out of telemetry if required.
Judge metrics cost tokens.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: OpenAI Evals

license.scope: MIT for framework code; contributed eval datasets may carry their own terms.

items.summary: Framework and registry of benchmarks for evaluating LLMs and LLM systems.
items.useWhen: Use as a reference for eval design and existing benchmark tasks rather than writing eval patterns from scratch.
cautions: Low recent activity; OpenAI now offers hosted evals in its platform.
Some datasets require Git LFS.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Inspect
items.summary: UK AI Security Institute framework for LLM and agent evaluations with sandboxed tool use and a log viewer.
items.useWhen: Use instead of building agentic eval harnesses with sandboxes and transcript logging yourself.
cautions: Agent evals execute tools; use the provided Docker sandboxes.
Calls are billed per token by the provider; use deterministic fakes in ordinary tests.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Langfuse

license.scope: MIT except ee/ directories, which require a commercial license.

items.summary: Open-source LLM engineering platform for tracing, prompt management, evals and cost/token analytics.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-building LLM trace storage and token/cost dashboards; per-trace token usage shows where to cut context.
cautions: Self-hosting needs Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis and object storage.
Traces contain prompts; apply retention and keep local-only data out of cloud instances.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Arize Phoenix

license.scope: Elastic License 2.0 (source-available): free to self-host, but providing it as a managed service and circumventing license keys is prohibited.

items.summary: OpenTelemetry-based LLM tracing, evaluation and dataset experimentation app.
items.useWhen: Use instead of building local trace viewers and eval experiment tracking for LLM apps.
cautions: Not OSI open source; review Elastic-2.0 before embedding in a hosted product.

items.name: Helicone

license.scope: Apache-2.0 for the open-source platform; Helicone Cloud is a paid hosted service.

items.summary: Open-source LLM observability gateway with request logging, caching, cost tracking and rate limits.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing a logging proxy; its response cache and cost views reduce repeated-prompt spend.
cautions: Proxying routes prompts through Helicone; self-host for sensitive data.
Self-hosting has multiple services (ClickHouse, Postgres).
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: OpenLLMetry
items.summary: OpenTelemetry instrumentations for LLM providers, vector DBs and frameworks.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-instrumenting LLM calls; emits standard OTel spans with token usage to any backend.
cautions: Spans may include prompt content; disable content tracing for sensitive data.

items.name: Ollama
items.summary: Runs open-weight models locally with a REST and OpenAI-compatible API; official Python/JS clients.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-packaging llama.cpp builds; offload cheap tasks (classification, summarization, embeddings) to local models at zero token cost.
cautions: Model licenses vary (Llama, Gemma, Qwen); check per model.
Bind to localhost; the API has no auth by default.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: llama.cpp
items.summary: C/C++ LLM inference with GGUF quantization, an OpenAI-compatible server and grammar-constrained output.
items.useWhen: Use instead of writing inference code; quantized models and GBNF grammars give cheap, valid local outputs on CPU, Metal, CUDA or Vulkan.
cautions: Rapid releases; pin a build tag.
Model weight licenses apply separately.

items.summary: High-throughput LLM serving engine with PagedAttention, prefix caching and an OpenAI-compatible server.

Expose behind auth; the server key option is minimal.

items.useWhen: Use as the end-user local model host instead of asking users to compile runtimes; point an OpenAI-compatible client at its local server.
cautions: App is not open source; check terms for commercial/workplace use.
Users must install it; detect availability rather than assuming it.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Hugging Face Transformers
items.summary: Model-definition library for text, vision, audio and multimodal models in PyTorch.
items.useWhen: Use instead of implementing model architectures; run small local classifiers or extractors to avoid paid API calls.

Heavy install; isolate in a worker.

items.summary: Runs Hugging Face models in the browser and Node via ONNX Runtime and WebGPU.
items.useWhen: Use instead of server round-trips for embeddings, classification or speech in the browser; keeps data on device.

WebGPU support varies by browser.

items.summary: Python framework of input/output validators (hub) for LLM responses with re-ask and structured output.

items.summary: NVIDIA toolkit for programmable rails (topical, jailbreak, fact-check) around conversational LLM apps.

Not a security boundary on its own.

items.name: Microsoft Presidio
items.summary: PII detection and anonymization for text, images and structured data.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-written PII regexes to redact data before prompts, logs or embeddings leave local systems.
cautions: Detection is probabilistic; record coverage gaps rather than claiming full protection.
Tune recognizers per language and locale.

items.name: LLM Guard
items.summary: Input/output scanners for prompt injection, PII, secrets and toxicity in LLM apps.
items.useWhen: Use instead of writing prompt-injection and secret scanners yourself for LLM inputs and outputs.
cautions: Scanners use local models and add latency.
Classifier results are signals, not authorization.

items.name: Tree-sitter
items.summary: Incremental parser generator with grammars for most languages and bindings for C, Rust, JS/WASM, Python and Go.
items.useWhen: Use instead of regex code parsing; extract symbols and signatures so agents read outlines rather than whole files, saving tokens.

Native bindings need a compiler; WASM avoids it.

items.summary: Tree-sitter based structural code search, lint and rewrite CLI with Node/Python APIs.
items.useWhen: Use instead of reading many files or fragile regex edits; precise structural matches return only relevant code to the agent.
cautions: Rewrites change code in bulk; review diffs and run tests.

items.name: Graphify
items.summary: Agent skill/CLI that maps a project (code via local tree-sitter, plus docs and media) into a queryable knowledge graph.
items.useWhen: Use instead of repeated grep-and-read passes; agents query graph.json and GRAPH_REPORT.md rather than re-reading files, cutting context tokens.

Young project with a commercial platform alongside; pin the CLI version.

items.summary: MCP coding-agent toolkit providing language-server-backed semantic symbol search and editing.
